grade.summary: The submission gives a complete and correct proof of both termination and choice-independence. The lexicographically decreasing pair consisting of the total prime-exponent sum and the number of entries greater than 1 proves termination, while the primewise gcd of all valuation coordinates is correctly shown to be invariant and reconstructs the unique terminal integer.
strengths: Correctly computes the valuation transformation as (e,f) -> (min(e,f), |e-f|).
Establishes strict lexicographic descent: the exponent sum decreases when gcd(m,n)>1, and otherwise the number of entries greater than 1 decreases.
Correctly proves that a move cannot eliminate all entries greater than 1, so a terminal board has exactly one such entry.
Uses the Euclidean-algorithm identity gcd(x,y)=gcd(min(x,y),|x-y|) to prove the primewise invariant.
Correctly reconstructs the terminal value M from the invariant valuation gcds, proving independence of all choices.
